children: Aeluma Inc. (ALMU) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 16, 2026.

On September 16, 2026, Aeluma, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, which were disclosed in the annual report on Form 10-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on September 16, 2026. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.

The information reported under this Item 2.02 of Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, is being furnished and shall not be deemed to be "filed" for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of such section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828805/000121390026100546/ea0305624-8k_aeluma.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828805/000121390026100546/0001213900-26-100546-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
